title: DC-area forecast: Fair skies tonight. A bit more humid Sunday with slight rain chance.
contentHtml:
Always a human at the helm: Updated around-the-clock by Capital Weather meteorologists.

Happening now: Mostly sunny with afternoon highs around 80 to 85. A quiet evening and night ahead as mostly clear skies hang on. Evening 70s dip to lows in the 60s for most.

What's next? Somewhat sunny and a bit more humid Sunday. Just a slight chance for a hit-or-miss shower or storm. More typical July heat returns Monday with an afternoon storm chance. Increasing clouds Tuesday as severe storm chances rise.

Forecast in detail

Tonight: More stars than clouds. Light breezes from the southeast calm overnight. Lows by dawn bottom out within a few degrees of 65. Cooler spots well north of town may dip into the 50s. A brief sprinkle or shower possible near sunrise. Confidence: Medium-High

Tomorrow (Sunday): At least partly sunny skies despite a slight chance for a shower near and after noon. Highs within a few degrees of 85, and a little more humid but not terrible (dew points in low to mid-60s). By mid-afternoon, a thunderstorm or two is possible. Confidence: Medium

Hourly Forecast | Pollen, Air & UV

Tomorrow night: Just a few showers and a rumble possible. Partly cloudy skies overall, with many of us staying dry. Muggier lows in the 60s to near 70. Confidence: Medium

📬 Get our forecast in your inbox

Our morning forecast email is back! It's included with every level of support — from Free to Founder — delivered 7 days a week. Sign up at: capitalweather.com/support-us

A look ahead

Typical July weather returns as the work week kicks off on Monday with mostly sunny skies, rising humidity, and highs reaching the upper 80s to low 90s. A building dip in the jet stream nearby brings the potential for an afternoon shower or thunderstorm. Perhaps a better chance of showers or storms Monday night with lows in the 70s. Confidence: Medium

Tuesday should bring increased rain chances at times. The afternoon into evening likely has the greatest potential for stronger storms as daytime heating helps add fuel. Isolated to scattered damaging winds, some hail, and potentially flooding will be the main factors to watch. Highs may trend a touch cooler with the extra clouds around, so mainly mid-80s to near 90. Confidence: Medium

Wednesday should start off with decreasing rain chances and increasing sunshine. Highs reach the mid- to upper 80s, with a chance for an afternoon shower. Confidence: Low-Medium

High pressure begins to build in by Thursday, allowing plenty of sunshine with highs in the mid-80s to near 90 and lower humidity. Confidence: Medium

Today’s daily digit — 8/10: Comfortable weather overall, but I'd take a little more sunshine. | 🤚 Your call?
The digit is a somewhat subjective rating of the day’s weather, on a 0-to-10 scale.

DC weather history for July 25

A violent 2010 thunderstorm outbreak followed intense heat, bringing destructive winds, fatalities, and widespread power outages.
